information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY4NDA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--386eec7bff35ac0a30c04cd2e512e282880a35e0/GAN%20MANILA%20SPEEDCUBING%20OPEN%202026%20BANNER.jpg) Welcome to **GAN Manila Speedcubing Open 2025**! This competition features the events 3x3, 5x5, 3x3 One-handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, Megaminx, Clock, and Skewb with 3x3 as the main event. We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing. This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences. This competition is proudly sponsored by **Learn How To Cube** and **GANCUBE**
